text.p: These are the main stories in Slovenia's Tuesday morning newspapers.
- The government adopted a 1997 budget proposal after prolonged negotiations on Monday evening.
- Parliament is expected to debate a law on takeovers during a session that starts on Tuesday. The law was previously vetoed by the upper house.
- Slovenian June industrial output rose 0.6 percent month/month and 0.8 percent year/year, the Statistical Office said.
- Swimmer Martin Strel became the first Slovenian to swim the English Channel.
- Some 84 percent of final-year high-school students successfully finished their end-of-school exams this summer.
- Salaries of Slovenian soldiers participating in international missions abroad are about two times higher than those received by soldiers at home but still lower than in most other countries.
- Ljubljana police arrested a forger who produced about 44 million fake tolars ($260,000).
- A group of MPs said it would suggest to parliament that the state council, the 40-member upper house, be moved to Slovenia's second largest city Maribor.
